title: Great pan - but the main handle broke during roasting.
text:
Great pan - but the main handle broke during roasting.. Wow - this is one beautiful, BIG frying pan! It arrived just in time to make the spaghetti sauce for the huge family group visiting over 4th of the July weekend. The best part of this pan is the "Helper" handle - what a difference in picking up this pan when it's full. It also is an absolute breeze to clean. We add sausage to our spaghetti sauce, and in our smaller pan, it was always a pain to get the pan clean afterward. No problems with this pan! I had never heard of GreenLife - but the quality is impressive. The lid fits perfectly. Whoever came up with adding that extra handle, deserves an award. What a convenience!

Amended 10/28/16: We have loved this pan and have used it almost daily. Tonight we decided to roast from lamb chops in it (with a basil sauce) and when we took it out of the oven, the main handle broke off - broke in the middle. The information said the pan was oven safe, and we are certain we were within the temperature limits. Very disappointed, as we used this pan all the time. So, if you decide to roast in it, be careful when you grip those handles - particularly the main one.
